svg.title: Transformations of the graph of y = f(x)
svg.desc: Four panels, each showing the graph of a function as a dashed curve beside the transformed graph: y equals f of x plus two shifted up two, y equals f of x minus two shifted right two, y equals minus f of x reflected in the x-axis, and y equals two f of x stretched vertically by scale factor two.
svg.text: Transformations of the graph of y = f(x)
The dashed curve is the original graph in every panel; the solid curve is the transformed one.
the shape is unchanged; the whole curve slides right
each y-coordinate is doubled; x is untouched
Inside the bracket the graph moves the opposite way to the sign: f(x − 2) shifts right, because the new graph needs the larger input
x = 2 to reuse the old value f(0). Stretches and reflections act on the outside (on y) and behave exactly as written.
